summary: MakeMyTrip Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 19, 2026, announcing its unaudited financial results for the quarter and full year ended March 31, 2026. The filing covers routine periodic earnings disclosure, including revenue, profit, and non-IFRS metrics, and incorporates the results by reference into an existing resale shelf registration statement. There are no terms related to a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. This is a standard earnings release, not a special situation.
